p.bio: Started sailing at age of 6. Single-handed journey took from Optimist through Europe, to Finn class. Multiple National Champion, Vice European Junior Champion, ran Olympic campaign for London 2012 and Rio 2016 Olympic games. In multi-handed classes mostly sailed Melges 24 (European Sportsboat Champion) and one design regattas (Vice World Universities Champion) as a skipper, tactician and main sail trimmer. Loves physical demanding sport activities like XTERRA and half Ironman distances triathlon

c: SSL Gold Cup Qualifying Series Round 3 (Fleet 1)
